author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at gameplay from Dwarf Legacy in this trailer for the upcoming bullet-hell precision platformer. Climb up vertical dungeons of The Mountainhome, battling relentless swarms of enemies and navigating perilous traps. Uncover the secret of your lost legacy hidden atop the highest peak and secure the future of your village. Dwarf Legacy will be available on PC in Q2 2026.
title: Dwarf Legacy - Official Gameplay Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the Rainbow Billy: The Book of Fears announcement teaser trailer for this upcoming story-driven investigative adventure game. Rainbow Billy: The Book of Fears takes place in a colorful summer camp where something feels… off. As strange events unfold, campers’ worries begin to manifest as curious creatures known as Fearlings. Rainbow Billy: The Book of Fears will be available on PC in 2026.
title: Rainbow Billy: The Book of Fears - Official Announcement Teaser Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out the first 12 minutes of gameplay from Malpraxis in this latest video for the upcoming game from the developers of Ratshaker. Malpraxis blends medical simulation, psychological horror, and investigative drama. This opening gameplay video showcases the S.P.I.D.E.R. unit startup sequence, shift briefing, a routine calibration exercise that quickly spirals into chaos, and the beginning of a grounded crew medical checkup.

Malpraxis will be available on PC on February 27, 2026. You can wishlist it on Steam if you're interested: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3350240/MALPRAXIS/

#Malpraxis #Gaming #IGN
title: Malpraxis - First 12 Minutes of Gameplay

author: GameTrailers
description:
Get a peek at the story of Deep Fog Signals in this teaser trailer for the upcoming single-player, story-driven horror puzzle game with 2D, hand-drawn graphics. Deep Fog Signals will be available on Steam in early 2026. 

Stuck in an outpost deep in a sea of toxic fog, your crew has been decimated, you're cut off from the outside world, and oxygen is running out. Use limited bandwidth to coordinate unstable crewmates, conduct esoteric research that could change the world, and interpret strange signals from the deep.

#DeepFogSignals #Gaming #IGN
title: Deep Fog Signals - Official Story Teaser Trailer

Players will traverse a delapitated world by way of magnetic gauntlets to overcome obstacles. Complete the job in Distant Shore: Bretagne, coming soon to PC (Steam), with a demo available now on Steam.

author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out gameplay and more from Wild Blue Skies in this latest trailer for the upcoming game that reimagines the classic on-rail adventures of the '90s. Join Bowie Stray and the Blue Bombers as they soar through the skies on a mission to save the world in this action-packed, nostalgic journey! Wild Blue Skies will be available on PC in 2026. A demo is out now on Steam as part of Steam Next Fest, which runs now until March 2, 2026.

#WildBlueSkies #Gaming #IGN

author: GameTrailers
description:
Here's a fresh look at gameplay from Gigils in this trailer for the upcoming action-packed multiplayer game, where players will take on the role of cute alien creatures that bite, evolve, and brawl to capture control points. Choose your class, devour bugs or enemies to unlock powerful abilities, and grow stronger. Alien mayhem has never been this delicious. Gigils will be available on PC, and a demo is out now on Steam.

#Gigils #Gaming #IGN
title: Gigils - Official Demo trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Get a deep dive into the gameplay of SuperWEIRD in this trailer for the upcoming automation roguelite. In SuperWEIRD, single-use JunkDroids turn out to be surprisingly useful: automate production network, rebuild a broken world piece by piece, and stop the Goofy Goo before it consumes everything. SuperWEIRD will be available on PC in 2026.

#SuperWEIRD #Gaming #IGN
